about: Fascinating musical journeys with an infusion of the Arts.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 23 Dec. The French Cuban Twins Ibeyi choose a foundational piece of music for the End of Days library. And, hear two unreleased tracks from the Aphex Twin 25th Anniversary edition of his groundbreaking album 'Drukqs'. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Ibeyi

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 16 Dec. Tyler guitarist from P**S joins us to select a track for the End of Days music library after the release of their debut album on Sub Pop, you made me/skin on linen, and there's world exclusive new music from Patrick Higgins & Nicolas Jaar's new project AEAEA. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: P + AEAEA

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 9 Dec. Organist and composer Kali Malone selects a piece for the End of Days music library ahead of her new album Burning Song, and we hear from Blackhaine with a premiere from his upcoming debut on XL Records, Saints in the Wethouse. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Kali Malone + Blackhaine

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 2 Dec. Ahead of the London run of Hamlet Hail to the Thief at the Barbican Theatre, Mary Anne Hobbs joins Thom Yorke alongside directors and Co-Creators Steven Hoggett and Christine Jones, actors Samuel Blenkin who plays Hamlet, Ami Tredrea who plays Ophelia, and arranger Justin Levine at rehearsals for their acclaimed collaboration that brings together Shakespeare's Hamlet and Radiohead's landmark 2003 album Hail to the Thief. Co-created by Yorke, Hoggett and Jones, the production fuses theatre, music and movement, reimagining Shakespeare's tragedy through the lens of Rad…
items.title: Thom Yorke, Christine Jones and Steven Hoggett, Hamlet Hail to the Thief

items.desc: Natural history filmmaker Kathryn Jeffs has worked on acclaimed series Planet Earth, Frozen Planet and Monsoon. Her latest project is Earth's Tropical Islands which will be broadcast on New Years Day on BBC 2. The series journeys to three of the most mysterious and remote islands on planet earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii and will reveal how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Mary Anne also lays down the All Queens Mix, a great choice of tunes from our favourite fierce females. Every day belongs to The Qu…
items.title: With Kathryn Jeffs
